build_FCOS3D_detector: build a FCOS3D single-stage 3D object detector model registered with the DETECTORS module
run_FCOS3D_forward_train: run the FCOS3D forward training pass with image metas, ground truth 3D bboxes, and labels
test_FCOS3D_simple_test: test the FCOS3D model by extracting features and getting 3D bounding box predictions from the bbox head
build_NuScenesMultiViewFCOS3D_aug_test: build a NuScenes multi-view FCOS3D augmentation test that aggregates and ranks 3D bbox results across views
review_FCOS3D_forward_test: review the FCOS3D forward test method that dispatches to simple_test or aug_test based on augmentation count
